data.body: **[P1] Deduplicate checkpointless virtual contexts across replays.** Virtual contexts never create a checkpoint, so their end hook derives `is_replayed` from `checkpointed_result.is_existent()`, which remains false on every replay. This guard therefore misses them, and `_ended_operation_ids` is reset each invocation, causing the same deterministic span ID to be exported repeatedly. Propagate a reliable replay marker for virtual contexts (or otherwise preserve execution-wide uniqueness) and add a virtual-context wait/resume test spanning multiple invocations.
